authoring: Original wordless staging follows source intent; timings and poses remain tunable.

source_intent.arc: Pip finds a seed and needs a tidy plot; each clear makes the sprout grow a leaf.
source_intent.clue: none. Mill far, sails idle.
source_intent.intro: Pip digs, drops the seed, pats it, looks up at the drizzle, then at the wizard (`question`).
source_intent.payoff: The sprout shoots up into a sunflower; Pip hangs the basket on it, plucks a leaf and stamps it with its paw: the first invite (`idea`).

source_intent.payoff: Each friend flops into a bed and snores (`sleep`); Pip tucks an invite under each pillow, shushes the wizard (`dots`), blows out the candle.
